<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Cabinet honors PM Modi:</strong> The Union Cabinet passed a resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi for becoming the longest-serving elected Prime Minister of India.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W24</a></span></li>
